feature: Show full pronunciation tips in all consonant lesson sound cards and compact compound-final cards to three information lines.
changes: Add each sound-specific articulation explanation to the selected letter card for d/t/n/l, g/k/h, j/q/x, zh/ch/sh/r, and z/c/s.
Keep the card header and letter/IPA prominent; allow the explanation to wrap completely without clipping.
Place each compound final and its IPA on one row, with the example reading and articulation cue on the next two rows.
Apply the compact three-line card consistently to ai/ei/ui, ao/ou/iu, and ie/üe/er.
unchanged: Audio playback, recording, lesson navigation, course order, quizzes, progress, and unlock behavior.
